name: Queralbs (Spain)
description: Green field with two juxtaposed central pales, white and orange, and a white heraldic rock on each side.
history: The flag was approved on 12 July 2006 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 4696 of 11 August 2006; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, green, with two juxtaposed central pales, the first white and the second orange, each 1/9 of the length, and a white heraldic rock at the centre of each side of the field.

features.role: heraldic rock (chess rook) at the centre of each green part
